fields.label: Title
fields.value: Valley Science Fair poster outshines others

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Photograph caption dated April 8, 1960 reads, "Science Poster - Peter L. Fritz, left, executive vice president of North Hollywood Federal Savings and Loan Association, greets Dough Friedlander, young artist who drew Valley Science Fair poster on display in association's office. Friedlander's was outstanding among local teenage art students' posters. Science Fair opens at North Hollywood High School at 1 p.m. tomorrow."
